_comment: SKR Staking Reward — data-driven config + tiers + perks + capped reward-pool accounting. Design source: WorkOrders/WORK_ORDER_skr_staking_and_seeker.md (Part A). Thin interpreter, no hardcoded branches: tiers/perks/pools are rows. Loaded via CanonicalJson.Read('Data/Canonical/skr_staking.json'); mirror to Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/ at implementation (WebGL pattern, same as packs.json). NO binary inlined: cosmeticSku/iconId are POINTER strings only. Covenant firewall: PerkGrant.kind has NO combat/stat kind; the SkrStakingRegression build gate rejects one.

config.cooldownNote: Mirrors the Solana Mobile SKR protocol's ~48h / 2-day-epoch unstake cooldown so the in-game UX matches real SKR.
config.skrRebateGateNote: Option (b) SKR rebate ships ONLY after the monetization-v2-spec.md sec/sweepstakes legal sign-off. Cosmetics (a) + store-discount (c) ship first with no gate. When false, tiers grant perks only and skr_rebate_share perks are skipped.

displayCopy.framing: Loyalty rewards for supporting Elarion — cosmetic and convenience only.
displayCopy.forbiddenLanguageNote: Security-optics discipline (WO Part A §A4). Never advertise a rate for the GAME reward; the protocol's native staking APY is Solana Mobile's, shown in their wallet, not ours.

stakeTiers.unlockDisclosure: Locks for 30 days. Unstake early anytime: you keep all cosmetics; only an unclaimed loyalty rebate (if any) is forfeited. Your SKR is always yours.
Locks for 90 days. Unstake early anytime: cosmetics kept, unclaimed rebate forfeited. Principal always returns to your spendable balance after the 48h cooldown.
Locks for 180 days. Unstake early anytime: cosmetics kept, unclaimed rebate forfeited. 48h cooldown then principal returns.

rewardPools.sourceNote: Funded ONLY from the owner's existing 1M-SKR STAKING YIELD (monetization-v2-spec.md §12), never principal, never minted. Invariant (regression-gated): paidSkr + reservedSkr <= fundedSkr, always. Interpreter checks the pool BEFORE crediting; on dry pool it FlowTrace.Warn()s and degrades to perks-only (never silent, never overdraws).

convenienceAllowListNote: Sanctioned convenience kinds ONLY (WO §A4 guardrail 1). Anything granting fire-rate, stat, cap-raise, or permanent power is rejected by SkrStakingRegression — pay-to-win firewall.
perkKindEnumNote: NO combat/stat kind exists. SkrStakingRegression fails the build if a perk kind outside this set appears.

sample_runtime_state._comment: ILLUSTRATIVE player-side state behind ISkrLedger (NOT authored content — shows the shapes the runtime persists). Demonstrates the staked sub-bucket, an active stake, a stake in cooldown, and a worked pool-invariant snapshot.

pendingRebates.claimNote: Shown as pending; real SKR payout occurs at Stage 3 (on-chain) from the §12 payouts vault, server-verified. Until then it is a tracked claim, never a minted balance.
